lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: LEVEL UP! LET'S GO!

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: More hit points. More hitting. Yes.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: I'm rolling for hit points. Lucky die, don't fail me.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Brannoc feels stronger. I feel stronger.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Pip levels up and does a little flip!

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Darlings, we're growing up so fast.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: New level, new accent. I'm kidding. Mostly.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Pip would like to thank the rat.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Oh nice. More heals.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Level up! Snacks are on me.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Oswin's god says congrats.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Nice. Who needs healing? Nobody? Great.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Champion. Crits on a 19. NINETEEN. Do you know how many more crits that is?

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Champion, obviously. Brannoc doesn't need tricks. He needs to hit harder.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: I'm going Champion. My lucky die has never been happier.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Champion. Big sword, bigger crits. That's the whole plan.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Banner Captain. Brannoc leads from the front now. Like a real captain.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Banner Captain. Everyone gets an extra swing when I yell. I'm great at yelling.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Banner Captain. Don't laugh. I want to keep you all standing.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Brannoc picks up a banner. He's not just a sword anymore. He's a sword with friends.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Spellguard. Sword AND magic. More numbers, more fun.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Brannoc learned a spell. One spell. He's very proud.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: I'm going Spellguard. Magic sword. Do I need to explain?

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Spellguard! Mara, you have to teach me how cantrips work.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Thief! Pip climbs everything now. Walls. Towers. Dev.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Pip goes Thief, which is honestly just a formality at this point.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Thief. Fast hands, faster feet, no regrets.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Darlings, Pip is a Thief. Officially. Hide your spoons.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Silvertongue, obviously. Pip could talk a dragon out of its hoard.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Pip goes Silvertongue. Every NPC in this town is about to fall in love with her.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Silvertongue! Expertise in lying. I mean persuading. Persuading.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: It had to be Silvertongue, darlings. It was always going to be Silvertongue.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Ambusher. Pip strikes first. Pip strikes from the trees. Pip strikes.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Ambusher! Advantage on initiative. Dev, I'm coming for your turn.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Pip goes Ambusher. Nobody sees her coming. Including Pip, sometimes.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Ambusher, darlings. Why fight fair when you can fight first?

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Life Domain. More heals. Everyone gets to go home.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Going Life. You keep falling over, I keep picking you up.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Life Domain, I think. Oswin just wants everyone okay.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Life. Not very exciting, but nobody drops on my watch.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Hearth Domain. Oswin is basically the party's kitchen now.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Going Hearth. Temporary hit points for everyone. And soup.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Hearth Domain. It's cozy. I like cozy.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Hearth, I think. Oswin keeps the fire going. That's kind of his whole thing.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Mischief Domain. Oswin's god has a sense of humor, it turns out.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Going Mischief. Decoy Oswin takes the hits so real Oswin doesn't have to.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Mischief Domain. I'm as surprised as you are.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Mischief. Oswin found a funny little god. He's happy.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Evoker. Thessaly has decided that sometimes the answer is fire.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Evocation. Even my cantrips hurt now. Dev, take notes.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I'm going Evoker. I've read a lot about it. Footnotes included.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Evoker. Thessaly is done being polite to monsters.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Wayfinder. Thessaly wants to see what's past the edge of the map.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I'm going Wayfinder. Misty Step, and I can bring a friend. Sam, you're the friend.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Wayfinder. Every road leads somewhere, and Thessaly wants to know where.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Wayfinder, because I want to explore everything. Even the parts that aren't there.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Mirror Mage. Illusions, reflections, and a lot of very confused goblins.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I'm going Mirror Mage. Things aren't always what they seem. Write that down.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Mirror Mage. Thessaly has learned that the truth is sometimes backwards.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Come in, come in. It's good to see a friendly face.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: {char}, isn't it? Sit down. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Ah, you're the ones everyone's talking about. Welcome.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: You look like you've had a long road. Sit. Rest a moment.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: What do you want? I've got work to do.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: I don't know you. Say what you came to say.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Keep your voice down. People here notice things.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Make it quick. I'm not looking for trouble.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Nothing's wrong here. Nothing at all. Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Me? I'm nobody. Just minding my own business.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Strangers? Haven't seen any. Quiet week.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Oh, I'd love to help. Truly. I just don't know a thing.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Alright. I'll tell you what I saw, but you didn't hear it from me.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: You've been straight with me, so here's the truth.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Sit closer. This isn't something I'd shout.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Fine. Someone ought to know. Here's what happened.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: I don't know anything about that. Try someone else.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: That's not my business, and it isn't yours either.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Ask me again and I'll call the watch.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Some things are better left alone. That's one.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: That? Just rumours. Nothing to it.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Never heard of it. You must be thinking of somewhere else.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: That was years ago. Long over now.

lines.speaker: anyone
lines.text: Go north, they say. That's where you'll find your answers.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Thank you. That's three pages of notes and a new theory. At least.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: That fits. That fits perfectly. I need a bigger notebook.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I'm grateful. Truly. And I'll remember who helped us.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I understand. I'll come back with better questions. And footnotes.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Of course. But you should know I'm very patient.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Noted. Your silence is also data, you know.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: That's the third time your story has changed. I'm counting.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Interesting. Page two of your story contradicts page one.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I don't think that's true. And I think you know it isn't.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I see. Well, that rules out my best theory. Back to the books.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Thank you. That's... not what I expected. I'll make a note.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Hm. Fine. I'll cross that off. In pencil.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Good. Thanks. That's what we needed.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Owe you one. I pay my debts.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Right. That helps. Let's go.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Fine. We'll find out the hard way. We usually do.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Don't want to talk? Okay. We'll be back.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Your choice. I'd have told us.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: You're lying. I can smell it from here.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Try that again. Slower. And honest this time.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Nope. Not buying it. Talk straight.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Huh. Okay. Didn't see that coming.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Fine. If you say so. Moving on.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: That's it? Alright. Thanks, I guess.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Darling, you're a treasure. Pip will tell everyone you're lovely.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Oh, that's delicious. Thank you, darling. Pip owes you a coin trick.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: See? Pip knew you had a heart under there. Lovely.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Fine, keep your secrets, darling. Pip has her ways.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Playing hard to get? Pip respects that. For now.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Darling, Pip will find out anyway. It's more fun if you tell.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Oh, darling. Pip invented that face. Try again.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Lying to a liar? Bold. Adorable, but bold.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Pip's rat doesn't believe you. And the rat is a very good judge.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Oh! Well, that's that, then. Pip had such hopes.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Really? How dull. Thank you, darling.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Huh. Pip didn't see that coming. Pip always sees it coming.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Thank you. Really. Here, take some bread. You've earned it.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: That helps a lot. Blessings on you.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Good. That's good. We'll be careful with it.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: That's alright. If you change your mind, you know where we'll be.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: No pressure. We'll manage. Stay safe, alright?

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Fair enough. Can't blame you for being careful.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: I don't think that's true. But I think you're scared. That's okay.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: You can tell us. Really. Whatever it is.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Something's off. You don't have to lie to us.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Oh. Okay. Thank you anyway.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Right. Well, that's that. Take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Alright. I suppose we'll look elsewhere.
